**Cephalexin does not have a direct, dangerous interaction with alcohol, nor does alcohol stop the antibiotic from working** . However, ` [Highlight start] drinking alcohol while taking cephalexin is generally discouraged because it can worsen side effects and slow your recovery [Highlight end] ` . As noted by the [NHS](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF19wsFD0gX1blruXJYwPH54lhCSNq3ofA7cr2-MNZ8mHP59ASAkP-b4Sad0F9gqzgZHRg_nV0HXuFYWbxbUjOYFhhrhJE9eBxkf6u4BrcN-RRg-0n2uWd0YTYy2GWlTkehN99S6MigFRkRmRpXqHxnAc15nPkXXkC9PpQ7jMxNQ) , drinking alcohol is permitted with cefalexin, though clinicians often recommend avoiding it until you feel better.⁠nhs.uk  +4[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF19wsFD0gX1blruXJYwPH54lhCSNq3ofA7cr2-MNZ8mHP59ASAkP-b4Sad0F9gqzgZHRg_nV0HXuFYWbxbUjOYFhhrhJE9eBxkf6u4BrcN-RRg-0n2uWd0YTYy2GWlTkehN99S6MigFRkRmRpXqHxnAc15nPkXXkC9PpQ7jMxNQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXLFvpEJzWz01O2zZ4rD13b4Oa7Rp7Hq4L9WMMxc0az2FekM2gSvewiwWsOJNYZAHMhkwggk6gXGr9hKkJ6GOyKtwn5pvpqlc7FxI2rVOn5qOEk_QpY25VXTwbSVxnvj-KyfaaRXVU9VE0FcQolq-v5gCVkcAUuEjePg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF12z00PbFCNxeWCXby_Vc-SMWtsMR0-beURmLa4_wXZIrY7RNxp4qZfNgi150nbeZGoj8sgNP5c2HDlAwqR66J9n5sbhOV9OuIRfDVzf4lRnkguv75vu1eqPiQlhe6H7cVYpwfriyy3d21kN-bBwkZn3s7yB20DKnf8yTrCdxFN6VlztAo241MteTMCsTJS03BQ)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX0SextZNRI4Hup0BTScxK5BXa3qhOMHEagK0CZG9i6RdZDLgvSYlpUPRyYT0hY27iOFzd7W3mNNiP_eFZhgEJUFrtNwsAP-rIf9toa8YiseVq5q7Bdu1kY322tEP6282l3H9znmgl4aBcnPAHIK-4OiDz1DAfwxvlOkE)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXpzfKMkMrGxLAutpUsGSA434PiwjqMrI7hVdaPFuQ2oGn6914FWWxDovNT7i9xuXjvq7LDom73UfBbiWuATX5r0P7-nkN7HGWehamHLm9YmPv21HeLJKESoVOtONdtXQmM71ntw)

### Why Doctors Often Recommend Avoiding Alcohol

- **Worsened side effects:** Both cephalexin and alcohol can cause nausea, stomach upset, vomiting, diarrhea, and dizziness. Combining them can make these symptoms stronger.⁠GoodRx  +1[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXpzfKMkMrGxLAutpUsGSA434PiwjqMrI7hVdaPFuQ2oGn6914FWWxDovNT7i9xuXjvq7LDom73UfBbiWuATX5r0P7-nkN7HGWehamHLm9YmPv21HeLJKESoVOtONdtXQmM71ntw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF12z00PbFCNxeWCXby_Vc-SMWtsMR0-beURmLa4_wXZIrY7RNxp4qZfNgi150nbeZGoj8sgNP5c2HDlAwqR66J9n5sbhOV9OuIRfDVzf4lRnkguv75vu1eqPiQlhe6H7cVYpwfriyy3d21kN-bBwkZn3s7yB20DKnf8yTrCdxFN6VlztAo241MteTMCsTJS03BQ)
- **Slower recovery:** Alcohol can disrupt sleep, cause dehydration, and temporarily weaken your immune response while your body is fighting an infection. For urinary tract infections (UTIs), alcohol may also irritate the bladder.⁠Medical News Today  +2[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXBIa-G8XMpH5yhzvEze1Hyhol57jihFIE0U2gBZPDixZEEVGHuUQ-P9dlSO_Pti3qjkkH_RpToIHtvj4QpgDIOYGP0IuPaQCjlV9jbzJeDqcUb0Ee7VR1FoKsHEnlIH0iOlaazuQB)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXpzfKMkMrGxLAutpUsGSA434PiwjqMrI7hVdaPFuQ2oGn6914FWWxDovNT7i9xuXjvq7LDom73UfBbiWuATX5r0P7-nkN7HGWehamHLm9YmPv21HeLJKESoVOtONdtXQmM71ntw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF12z00PbFCNxeWCXby_Vc-SMWtsMR0-beURmLa4_wXZIrY7RNxp4qZfNgi150nbeZGoj8sgNP5c2HDlAwqR66J9n5sbhOV9OuIRfDVzf4lRnkguv75vu1eqPiQlhe6H7cVYpwfriyy3d21kN-bBwkZn3s7yB20DKnf8yTrCdxFN6VlztAo241MteTMCsTJS03BQ)
- **Harder to track symptoms:** Hangovers or alcohol-related side effects can mimic or mask infection symptoms or medication reactions.⁠www.rehab4alcoholism.com  +1[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXLFvpEJzWz01O2zZ4rD13b4Oa7Rp7Hq4L9WMMxc0az2FekM2gSvewiwWsOJNYZAHMhkwggk6gXGr9hKkJ6GOyKtwn5pvpqlc7FxI2rVOn5qOEk_QpY25VXTwbSVxnvj-KyfaaRXVU9VE0FcQolq-v5gCVkcAUuEjePg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF12z00PbFCNxeWCXby_Vc-SMWtsMR0-beURmLa4_wXZIrY7RNxp4qZfNgi150nbeZGoj8sgNP5c2HDlAwqR66J9n5sbhOV9OuIRfDVzf4lRnkguv75vu1eqPiQlhe6H7cVYpwfriyy3d21kN-bBwkZn3s7yB20DKnf8yTrCdxFN6VlztAo241MteTMCsTJS03BQ)
- **Missed doses:** Drinking can make it easier to forget a scheduled dose of your antibiotic.⁠www.rehab4alcoholism.com[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXLFvpEJzWz01O2zZ4rD13b4Oa7Rp7Hq4L9WMMxc0az2FekM2gSvewiwWsOJNYZAHMhkwggk6gXGr9hKkJ6GOyKtwn5pvpqlc7FxI2rVOn5qOEk_QpY25VXTwbSVxnvj-KyfaaRXVU9VE0FcQolq-v5gCVkcAUuEjePg)

### Important Caveats

- **Disulfiram-like reactions:** Certain other cephalosporin antibiotics (such as cefotetan or cefoperazone) can cause a severe reaction—flushing, fast heartbeat, nausea, and low blood pressure—when mixed with alcohol. While cephalexin is not typically linked to this reaction, it belongs to the same antibiotic class.⁠ubiehealth.com  +2[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF12z00PbFCNxeWCXby_Vc-SMWtsMR0-beURmLa4_wXZIrY7RNxp4qZfNgi150nbeZGoj8sgNP5c2HDlAwqR66J9n5sbhOV9OuIRfDVzf4lRnkguv75vu1eqPiQlhe6H7cVYpwfriyy3d21kN-bBwkZn3s7yB20DKnf8yTrCdxFN6VlztAo241MteTMCsTJS03BQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXpzfKMkMrGxLAutpUsGSA434PiwjqMrI7hVdaPFuQ2oGn6914FWWxDovNT7i9xuXjvq7LDom73UfBbiWuATX5r0P7-nkN7HGWehamHLm9YmPv21HeLJKESoVOtONdtXQmM71ntw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX6p8BsVN_1UaY2J1fU-6Bi_0yODKzKUnAyrSAlYarl0pqlhDoii1sBURj1uhz1oIL-BfRTnUzz9HWA3_aGrrWMEHrNKNtOeGExlZyM8ZlVQFWBgcv-qQI3AHzsNylw3j3qNo8U29tBA)
- **Kidney function and other medications:** Your kidneys clear cephalexin from your body, and your overall health or other prescriptions may change how you tolerate alcohol. A breakdown of alcohol and antibiotic interactions is available in Fact versus Fiction: a Review of the Evidence behind Alcohol and Antibiotic Interactions , and further context on drinking patterns is covered by [Rehab 4 Alcoholism](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXLFvpEJzWz01O2zZ4rD13b4Oa7Rp7Hq4L9WMMxc0az2FekM2gSvewiwWsOJNYZAHMhkwggk6gXGr9hKkJ6GOyKtwn5pvpqlc7FxI2rVOn5qOEk_QpY25VXTwbSVxnvj-KyfaaRXVU9VE0FcQolq-v5gCVkcAUuEjePg).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXpzfKMkMrGxLAutpUsGSA434PiwjqMrI7hVdaPFuQ2oGn6914FWWxDovNT7i9xuXjvq7LDom73UfBbiWuATX5r0P7-nkN7HGWehamHLm9YmPv21HeLJKESoVOtONdtXQmM71ntw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF12z00PbFCNxeWCXby_Vc-SMWtsMR0-beURmLa4_wXZIrY7RNxp4qZfNgi150nbeZGoj8sgNP5c2HDlAwqR66J9n5sbhOV9OuIRfDVzf4lRnkguv75vu1eqPiQlhe6H7cVYpwfriyy3d21kN-bBwkZn3s7yB20DKnf8yTrCdxFN6VlztAo241MteTMCsTJS03BQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXLjNc4AfMi1i1PnN4UcCZx4s7MHZacPR6mn6z8lhGH6vbIuVs1afKm7bqHAVeHuYB1wPzvt0MixOtHiHdlpkHMIEBMi1PYdGzKO1kyO_9Q5BykvMcM3yxM3nakJlRawOmBdmGjBAR0A)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXLFvpEJzWz01O2zZ4rD13b4Oa7Rp7Hq4L9WMMxc0az2FekM2gSvewiwWsOJNYZAHMhkwggk6gXGr9hKkJ6GOyKtwn5pvpqlc7FxI2rVOn5qOEk_QpY25VXTwbSVxnvj-KyfaaRXVU9VE0FcQolq-v5gCVkcAUuEjePg)
